    direction TB

    %% ======== UC-01 ========

    %% People - table `users`
    class User{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(255)
        email : varchar(255)
        password : varchar(255)
        role : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(255)
        failedLoginAttempts : smallint
    }

    %% Term - table `audit_logs`
    class AuditLog{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        action : varchar(64)
        subjectType : varchar(64)
        properties : json
        createdAt : timestamp
    }

    %% ======== UC-02 ========

    %% People - table `student_profiles`
    class StudentProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        matricNo : varchar(32)
        programCode : varchar(8)
        yearOfStudy : smallint
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% People - table `supervisor_profiles`
    class SupervisorProfile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        programCode : varchar(8)
        capacityPsm1 : smallint
        capacityPsm2 : smallint
    }

    %% Registration - table `supervisor_agreements`
    class SupervisorAgreement{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        supervisorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        proposedTitle1 : varchar(255)
        agreedTitle : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(255)
        studentSignedAt : timestamp
        supervisorAcknowledgedAt : timestamp
    }

    %% Registration - table `supervision_assignments`
    class SupervisionAssignment{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        supervisorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        isActive : boolean
        effectiveFrom : date
        effectiveUntil : date
        endedAt : timestamp
    }

    %% Registration - table `project_members`
    class ProjectMember{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        isLeader : boolean
    }

    %% Registration - table `student_enrolments`
    class StudentEnrolment{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        attemptNo : smallint
        status : varchar(32)
        repeatsEnrolmentId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% Chain - table `lampiran_b_forms`
    class LampiranBForm{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        revisionNo : smallint
        title : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(32)
        rejectedReason : text
        supersededById : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% ======== UC-03 ========

    %% Chain - table `projects`
    class Project{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        status : varchar(255)
        agreementId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% Chain - table `milestones`
    class Milestone{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        milestoneTemplateItemId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        attempt : smallint
        status : varchar(32)
        dueAt : date
        lampiranCBy : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% Chain - table `submission_files`
    class SubmissionFile{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        uploadedBy : bigint <<FK>>
        originalName : varchar(255)
        revisionNo : smallint
        isCurrent : boolean
        supersededById : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% Chain - table `milestone_reviews`
    class MilestoneReview{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        reviewerId : bigint <<FK>>
        roundNo : smallint
        ackReceived : boolean
        ackReviewed : boolean
        verdict : varchar(32)
        totalScore : numeric
        maxScore : numeric
    }

    %% ======== UC-04 ========

    %% People - table `sections`
    class Section{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(16)
        name : varchar(128)
        courseCode : varchar(16)
        lecturerId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% People - table `lecturer_marks`
    class LecturerMark{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        affective : numeric
        cognitive : numeric
        psychomotor : numeric
        enteredBy : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% Registration - table `examiner_pairs`
    class ExaminerPair{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(64)
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        examiner1Id : bigint <<FK>>
        examiner2Id : bigint <<FK>>
        isActive : boolean
    }

    %% Registration - table `examiner_assignments`
    class ExaminerAssignment{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        examinerId : bigint <<FK>>
        examinerPairId : bigint <<FK>>
        panelRole : varchar(32)
        isActive : boolean
    }

    %% Assessment - table `rubric_templates`
    class RubricTemplate{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        formCode : varchar(8)
        psmPart : varchar(20)
        assessorType : varchar(20)
        version : smallint
        totalMarks : numeric
        isPublished : boolean
    }

    %% Assessment - table `rubric_components`
    class RubricComponent{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        rubricTemplateId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        weightPercent : numeric
        sequence : smallint
    }

    %% Assessment - table `rubric_criteria`
    class RubricCriterion{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        rubricComponentId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        weightPercent : numeric
        maxMarks : numeric
    }

    %% Assessment - table `assessment_windows`
    class AssessmentWindow{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        formCode : varchar(16)
        psmPart : varchar(16)
        status : varchar(16)
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        openedAt : timestamp
        closedAt : timestamp
    }

    %% Assessment - table `evaluations`
    class Evaluation{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        assessorId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricTemplateId : bigint <<FK>>
        assessorType : varchar
        psmPart : varchar
        status : varchar
        rawScore : numeric
        maxScore : numeric
        scorePercent : numeric
        finalScore : numeric
        isLateAssessment : boolean
        submittedAt : timestamp
        releasedAt : timestamp
    }

    %% Assessment - table `evaluation_scores`
    class EvaluationScore{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        evaluationId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricComponentId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricCriterionId : bigint <<FK>>
        itemScore : smallint
        marks : numeric
    }

    %% ======== UC-05 ========

    %% People - table `coordinator_scopes`
    class CoordinatorScope{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        programme : varchar(8)
    }

    %% Results - table `final_grades`
    class FinalGrade{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        finalMark : numeric
        releasedAt : timestamp
        releasedBy : bigint <<FK>>
    }

    %% Results - table `mark_submissions`
    class MarkSubmission{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        finalGradeId : bigint <<FK>>
        status : varchar(255)
        expectedPanelSize : smallint
    }

    %% Results - table `grade_schemes`
    class GradeScheme{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        passMark : numeric
    }

    %% ======== UC-06 ========

    %% Term - table `academic_semesters`
    class AcademicSemester{
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(255)
        isActive : boolean
        startsAt : date
        endsAt : date
    }

    %% ---- Associations ----
    %% Mermaid's documented form: a bare arrow with quoted
    %% cardinalities either side. Crow's-foot tokens (`||--o{`)
    %% belong to an ER grammar and render as NO LINE AT ALL here.
    %% `*--` is composition: the part cannot outlive the whole.

    User <|-- StudentProfile : is a
    User <|-- SupervisorProfile : is a
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : holds
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..1" Section : sits in
    User "1" --> "0..*" Section : lectures
    User "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : keys
    Section "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : records
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : earns
    User "1" --> "0..*" CoordinatorScope : scoped as
    User "1" --> "0..*" AuditLog : acts
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" SupervisorAgreement : files
    SupervisorProfile "0..1" --> "0..*" SupervisorAgreement : signs
    SupervisorAgreement "1" --> "0..1" Project : becomes
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" SupervisionAssignment : paired by
    SupervisorProfile "1" --> "0..*" SupervisionAssignment : supervises
    SupervisorAgreement "0..1" --> "0..1" SupervisionAssignment : confirmed by
    StudentEnrolment "1" --> "0..1" Project : starts
    StudentEnrolment "0..1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : repeats
    User "1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : enrols
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" ProjectMember : has
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" ProjectMember : takes part as
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" Milestone : carries
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" LampiranBForm : files
    Milestone "0..1" --> "0..*" LampiranBForm : carried by
    SupervisorProfile "0..1" --> "0..*" LampiranBForm : files for
    LampiranBForm "0..1" --> "0..1" LampiranBForm : superseded by
    Milestone "1" *-- "0..*" SubmissionFile : holds
    Milestone "1" *-- "0..*" MilestoneReview : reviewed by
    User "1" --> "0..*" SubmissionFile : uploads
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" MilestoneReview : reviews
    RubricTemplate "1" *-- "0..*" RubricComponent : contains
    RubricComponent "1" *-- "0..*" RubricCriterion : breaks into
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" Evaluation : assessed by
    User "1" --> "0..*" Evaluation : assesses
    RubricTemplate "1" --> "0..*" Evaluation : governs
    Evaluation "1" *-- "0..*" EvaluationScore : scores
    RubricComponent "0..1" --> "0..*" EvaluationScore : measured by
    RubricCriterion "0..1" --> "0..*" EvaluationScore : measured by
    AcademicSemester "1" --> "0..*" AssessmentWindow : runs
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : panel of
    User "1" --> "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : examines
    StudentProfile "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : seated for
    ExaminerPair "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerAssignment : seats
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" ExaminerPair : pairs in
    User "2" --> "1" ExaminerPair : examiner 1 / examiner 2
    Project "1" --> "0..1" FinalGrade : results in
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" FinalGrade : awarded
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" FinalGrade : releases
    Project "1" *-- "0..*" MarkSubmission : closed by
    StudentProfile "1" --> "0..*" MarkSubmission : submits
    FinalGrade "0..1" --> "0..*" MarkSubmission : published by
    Project "1" --> "0..*" GradeScheme : graded under
    AcademicSemester "1" --> "0..*" StudentEnrolment : enrols
    AcademicSemester "1" --> "0..*" Section : provisions
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" Project : placed in
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" StudentProfile : cohort of
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" SupervisorAgreement : filed in
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" LecturerMark : keyed in
    AcademicSemester "0..1" --> "0..*" MarkSubmission : closed in
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" Project : created or approved by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" SupervisorAgreement : decided by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" SupervisionAssignment : assigned by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" LampiranBForm : rejected by *
    User "0..1" --> "0..*" Milestone : reviewed, signed or overridden by *

    User "0..1" --> "0..*" AssessmentWindow : opened, closed or created by *
